passage:
enrolled — 注册；报名
The centre expected 40 students, but only 12 enrolled.

attending — 出席；参加
The course ran for eight weeks, and by the end, only five students were still attending.

advertised — 做广告；宣传
Sarah added, 'We also advertised the course only on our website.

survey — 调查
They sent a short survey to all 12 students who enrolled.

completion — 完成；结束
The completion rate was much higher, which suggested that the changes had made a positive difference and that the evidence-based approach had been worthwhile.

taster — 体验（课）
They also added a short 'taster' session before the course began, so students could try before enrolling.

evidence — 证据
Let's collect evidence.' Her response showed the importance of testing assumptions rather than acting on opinion alone, and it set the direction for the team's next steps.

improve — 改进；提高
This was a serious problem, because low enrolment and poor attendance meant the course was not achieving its purpose of helping adults improve their digital skills for employment.
